metadata.title: Ejection of hypervelocity binary stars by a black hole of intermediate mass orbiting Sgr A*

notes: No identifiable star qualifies. At T:p1-b10 the paper refers only to an anonymous population of known HVSs (“several HVSs are known”), without naming or otherwise identifying individual stars; T:p1-b7 and T:p1-b12 discuss hypothetical HVBs produced by an IMBH rather than observed Galactic unbound candidates. No star is individually selected, analyzed, or treated as a prior Galactic unbound candidate.
